Source.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/20] Children's Depression Inventory (CDI). The CDI (Kovacs, 1983, 1992) is a 27-item self-rated symptom-oriented scale; [/page/4/Text/4] Piers-Harris Children's Self-Concept Scale (PHCSCS). The PHCSCS (Piers, 1972; Piers & Harris, 1984) consists of 79 items, which are answered with a "yes" or "no" response. Items follow the pattern developed by Jersild (1952), in which the student is asked to answer according to what he or she likes or dislikes about him- or herself.; [/page/4/Text/5] Social Adjustment Scale for Children and Adolescents (SASCA). The SASCA (Beiser, 1990) is a self-administered instrument; [/page/4/Text/6] Family Emotional Involvement and Criticism Scale (FEICS). The FEICS (Shields, Franks, Harp, McDaniel, & Campbell, 1992) is a selfadministered instrument; [/page/4/Text/7] CBCL. The adolescent version of the CBCL (CBCL-A) and the CBCL-P (Achenbach & Edelbrock, 1983) are instruments that measure social abilities and behavior problems in children and adolescents.
Source.warning: Assumed CBCL-A is youth self-report (Source 1) and CBCL-P is parent report (Source 2) based on common usage, as specific raters for CBCL versions are not explicitly stated.
